description: Inspect supplied role summaries and any supported owner-local authority evidence. A supplied role is a declaration, not verified permission; roles belong to each agreement. Inspect caller-supplied role summaries and any supported local authority evidence. Each agreements row has exactly id, kind and parties (role to direct Ed25519 public key). Do not pass a contract-draft wrapper. Read https://jupie202020.pythonanywhere.com/review-reference.json for examples. A declared role is not verified permission; this does not authorize signing, payment or execution.

agreements.description: Caller-declared role summaries. Each row has exactly id, kind and parties; parties maps role names to supported public verification keys. These are not signed contract wrappers.

expected_heads.description: Optional retained sorted causal heads for the group review.

grants.description: Optional exact grant records for owner-local access review; do not provide private keys or credentials.

group.description: Optional exact group reference; it does not appoint a controller or grant authority.

policies.description: Optional exact policy records; declarations are separate from installed authority.

name: covenant_review__authority
